propositions: CLI facade reconstructs command identity through 19 overlapping frozensets and 54 hand-maintained help resources, creating parser/help drift risk and incomplete canonical help for 21 intercept-only commands.

Every command's runtime parsing and generated syntax/options must derive from a single side-effect-free argparse factory used by both execution and build-time generation, eliminating manual syntax authority.

Help and unknown-command output must return byte-current generated package data before operation/config/mount/handler boundaries, with lazy execution preserving mount/init/argv/confirmation/stream/exit-code contracts.

Command spellings (exact/compatibility/hidden/retired) including jira-onboard and unknown purge-bridge must exhibit approved behavior with canonical identity and lazy handler/parser references in an immutable route registry.
CLI reference, coverage, lean-wheel, and full-extra checks must enumerate parser/route artifacts and registries rather than source regexes or manual command censuses.
Optional modes and backends must register capabilities with postures (error/unavailable/abstain/fallback) without eager optional imports, with checks deferred until mode/backend is known.
